verbs.name: build
verbs.description: Compile or transpile project sources into runnable or distributable outputs.

verbs.name: test
verbs.description: Run the project's tests, emitting test counts and coverage metrics.

verbs.name: lint
verbs.description: Check code for style and correctness findings, emitting per-issue diagnostics.

verbs.name: serve
verbs.description: Run the project's dev server until interrupted.

verbs.name: run
verbs.description: Execute the project once and exit.

verbs.name: package
verbs.description: Assemble distributable artifacts for the project's publish channels.

verbs.name: deploy
verbs.description: Converge a cloud environment on the workload's aggregated infra manifest.

verbs.name: validate
verbs.description: Check the project against its declared specs, contracts and compatibility rules.
